### Nested Schema for `dns_type_choice.primary.rr_set_group.rr_set.type_record_set_choice.naptr_record`

Required:

- `name` (String) Record Name NAPTR Record name, please provide only the specific subdomain or record name without the base domain.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_type_choice--primary--rr_set_group--rr_set--type_record_set_choice--naptr_record--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_type_choice.primary.rr_set_group.rr_set.type_record_set_choice.naptr_record.values`

Optional:

- `flags` (String) Flags Flag to control aspects of the rewriting and interpretation of the fields in the record. At this time only four flags, S/A/U/P, are defined.
- `order` (Number) Order Order in which the NAPTR records must be processed. A lower number indicates a higher preference.
- `preference` (Number) Preference Preference when records have the same order. A lower number indicates a higher preference.
- `regexp` (String) Regular Expression Regular expression to construct the next domain name to lookup.
- `replacement` (String) Replacement The next NAME to query for NAPTR, SRV, or address records depending on the value of the flags field.
- `service` (String) Protocol Resolution Service Specifies the service(s) available down this rewrite path.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_type_choice--secondary--tsig_key_value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_type_choice.secondary.tsig_key_value`

Required:

- `secret_info_choice` (Attributes) SecretInfoOneof Secret can be one of the following types - * Blindfold Secret - Secret is managed by F5XC Secret Management System * Clear Secret - Secret is not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_type_choice--secondary--tsig_key_value--secret_info_choice))

<a id="nestedatt--dns_type_choice--secondary--tsig_key_value--secret_info_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_type_choice.secondary.tsig_key_value.secret_info_choice`

Optional:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_type_choice--secondary--tsig_key_value--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))
- `clear_secret_info` (Attributes) Clear Secret Clear Secret is used for the secrets that are not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_type_choice--secondary--tsig_key_value--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info))

<a id="nestedatt--dns_type_choice--secondary--tsig_key_value--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_type_choice.secondary.tsig_key_value.secret_info_choice.blindfold_secret_info`

Required:

- `location` (String) Location Location is the uri_ref. It could be in url format for string:/// Or it could be a path if the store provider is an http/https location

Optional:

- `decryption_provider` (String) Decryption Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the backend Secret Management service.
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///


<a id="nestedatt--dns_type_choice--secondary--tsig_key_value--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_type_choice.secondary.tsig_key_value.secret_info_choice.clear_secret_info`

Required:

- `url` (String) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.

Optional:

- `provider_dns_zone` (String) Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///
